turns.content: A bridge hand contains 13 cards selected from a standard 52-card deck. Does the hand depend on dealing order, and which counting method applies?
Write the number of distinct hands in compact combinatorial notation.
Expand that expression into factorial form.
Replace the deck size by 54 cards and evaluate the number of 13-card hands under the existing method.
Give an independent consistency check that does not simply restate the result.
Report the count and the sample-space interpretation.
